newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean May industrial output rises 6.1 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean May industrial output rises 6.1 pct yr/yr.

text.p: South Korea's industrial output rose 6.1 percent year-on-year in May, down from a 10.0 percent rise a year earlier, provisional National Statistical Office figures showed on Sunday.
NOTE - Figures in percent, year-on-year change.
The office said the year-on-year inventory growth in May was the lowest level in 20 months since it rose by 11.3 percent in September 1995.
It said the inventory growth slowed mainly due to a recovery in exports, especially in such sectors as automobiles and semiconductors, while industrial output slowed.
Industrial output in May fell by 2.8 percent from April, compared with 1.2 percent month-on-month growth a year ago.

The office attributed the month-on-month drop in industrial output to production cuts by major local carmakers to adjust their inventory levels. Automobile production in May fell 4.2 percent from the previous month.
Heavy-industrial sectors continued to lead the industrial output growth by posting a 9.4 percent output growth on the year while light industries posted a 6.6 percent drop.
It said ex-factory shipment for exports grew 23.0 percent in May from a year earlier, compared with a 1.4 percent rise in delivery for the domestic market.
